title: 10m to DT-HotTub/Pool TB/Karaoke -Johnny Cash HM
description:
Welcome to the MusicRowRental on the Cumberland! An intimate complex of 6 luxury townhomes each has it’s own theme such as Johnny Cash, Dolly Parton and Taylor Swift. They have shared access to a courtyard with games, bbq and hot tub. MSG me if you need more than 1 unit!

Live like a local in this Jonny Cash Nashville airbnb. Located 4 miles to lower Broadway where all the Honky Tonks are. The home has 3b3b, Karaoke, shared hot tub access and more! Easy uber ride to Airport and Broadway

The space
All the fun that music city has to offer is just a quick uber ride away!
- Broadway (11min - 3.9mi)
- The Gulch (13 min)
-Germantown (8 min)
-Nissan Stadium (6 min -2.3mi)

* 3 bedrooms
* 3 Bathrooms
* Karaoke!
* Fully stocked kitchen w bar seating
* Spacious living room
* Washer/Dryer
* One-car garage parking/Two-car driveway parking& Limited street parking
* Smart TV's/WiFi
* beer pong game 
* Early bag drop off upon request
* PET friendly ! $150

There are three levels with 15-20 stairs between each level 

Level 1
Garage with Karaoke and pool table (the pool table is damaged a little bit but totally functions)
Bedroom 1 - 2 full beds

Level 2
Kitchen, living and dining space
Sofa Bed and Murphy bed
Full bath accessible to living space

Level 3
Bedroom 2 - Queen bed and a full over full bunk bed with private attached full bath and private balcony , En Suite Bathroom
Bedroom 3 - Queen bed with private attached full bath and private balcony, En Suite Bathroom

Guest access
We welcome your pups but require a $150 pet fee. We just ask that you try to keep them off of all furniture. Excess hair and fur on the furniture requires additional cleaning from our cleaning staff and will result in additional charges. Pets must be leashed in the shared backyard for the safety of other guests.

Other things to note
1. The courtyard is shared between the 6 units in the complex and first come first serve. This means all amenities there are shared as well! this includes:
-Hot Tub
-BBQ Grills
-Yard Games
-Outdoor Furniture

Charcoal for the grills is not provided.

2. We have outdoor security camera installed on the garage and inside shared backyard

3. Like most of the 3-4br newly built townhomes in Nashville. There are three levels in the house with 15-20 stairs between each level. There is one bedroom on first floor and no bathroom on the first floor

4. Our check in time is 3pm and check out time is 10am. We charge $50 for early check in and $50 for late check out. Early check in time need to be agreed upon and money request need to be accepted at least 24 hours ahead of check in time to schedule cleaning accordingly.

5. Since our listing is for up to 12 people only. We provide 2-3 body towels and two washcloths per bed and one hand towel per bathroom. If these are not enough we have laundry machine on site and provide detergent. We don't provide service to deliver extra towels in the middle of your stay.

6. Our cancellation policy is strictly enforced, and no exceptions will be made, including for circumstances related to weather, medical issues, or other unforeseen events. This also include change of travel dates. For example. if you chose “non refundable” when you book, that means changing of travel dates is not allowed either 

7. Pet fee is $150 for single listing and $250 for duo listing. You must add number of pets when you make the reservation. We ask that you leash your pets at all times at shared backyard for the safety of other guests. These types of dogs are not allowed: Pit bulls, Rottweilers, Doberman Pinschers, German Shepherds and Neapolitan Mastiffs.
